motivo: Todas las afirmaciones fácticas coinciden con las páginas del NWS (weather.gov/safety/winter-lake-effect-snow y weather.gov/apx/les). Las unidades (pulgadas por hora, millas) coinciden con la fuente. No hay afirmaciones falsas, dudosas ni probables; los datos de clima y seguridad están verificados. Observaciones menores no bloqueantes: 'merge' es paráfrasis de 'form and grow into a narrow band', y 'next town/next one over' generaliza 'a mile or two away' (el caveat de la frase 7 y del caption lo acota).

afirmaciones.texto: Your town can be buried in snow while the next one over is sunny. / Buried in snow while the next town is sunny?
afirmaciones.fuente: NWS, weather.gov/safety/winter-lake-effect-snow: snow can fall in one spot while 'the sun may be shining just a mile or two away'

afirmaciones.texto: Cold air, often from Canada, blows across the Great Lakes. / moves across the open waters of the Great Lakes
afirmaciones.fuente: NWS Gaylord weather.gov/apx/les y página NWS safety: 'cold air, often originating from Canada, moves across the open waters of the Great Lakes'

afirmaciones.texto: The open water is relatively warm, so it adds heat and moisture to the air. / The lake adds heat and moisture to the lowest layer of air
afirmaciones.fuente: NWS Gaylord weather.gov/apx/les (lagos 'relatively warm', el aire gana calor y humedad); NWS safety: warmth and moisture transferred into the lowest portion of the atmosphere

afirmaciones.texto: That air rises, and the clouds merge into a narrow band. / it rises, and the clouds merge into a narrow band
afirmaciones.fuente: NWS safety: 'The air rises, clouds form and grow into narrow band'; NWS Gaylord: el aire calentado es menos denso y sube; bandas 'discrete, narrow'

afirmaciones.texto: The National Weather Service says one band can drop two to three inches of snow an hour, or more. / 2 to 3 inches of snow per hour or more
afirmaciones.fuente: NWS, weather.gov/safety/winter-lake-effect-snow: 'narrow band that produces 2 to 3 inches of snow per hour or more' (pulgadas, coincide)

afirmaciones.texto: Heads up: it's so narrow that the sun can be shining a mile or two away. / snow can fall in one spot while it's sunny just a mile or two away
afirmaciones.fuente: NWS, weather.gov/safety/winter-lake-effect-snow: 'the sun may be shining just a mile or two away in either direction' (millas, coincide)

afirmaciones.texto: Source: National Weather Service (weather.gov) (atribución del caption)
